business.description: E & E Enterprises Limited (formerly The Swastik Safe Deposit and Investments Limited) was incorporated on August 6, 1940. During the year, the Company voluntarily surrendered its Certificate of Registration as an NBFC to the RBI, which was cancelled on July 24, 2025. The Company is now engaged in the business of acquiring, undertaking, promoting, running, managing, owning, leasing, converting, building, hiring, letting on hire hotels, restaurants, café, rest houses and purchasing, selling or dealing in all types of movable or immovable properties for development, investment, leasing or for resale.

products.name: Real Estate Development and Investment
products.note: Company has only one business segment i.e. business of real estate and does not have any other business segment.

outlook.statement: The long-term outlook for the Indian real estate sector remains positive. The Company intends to increase sales velocity and enhance shareholder value. The Company remains optimistic about sustained demand supported by urbanisation and infrastructure development.
The Company has amended its Memorandum of Association (MOA) to reflect the change in its principal business objectives.

risks: Economic slowdowns affecting consumer sentiment and purchasing power
Changes in regulatory and taxation frameworks
Interest rate fluctuations impacting housing affordability
Construction cost inflation and supply chain disruptions
The Company does not deal in commodities and during the year under review, there were no commodity hedging activities

borrowings.note: Debt-Equity Ratio and Debt Service Coverage Ratio are not applicable as the Company has no debts.
The company does not have any loans or other borrowings from any lender

auditor.opinion: The Auditors Report for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026 does not contain any qualification, reservation or adverse remark or disclaimer on the financial statements and no frauds have been reported by the Auditors.
qualifications_or_emphasis: Emphasis of Matter: Company's voluntary surrender of its Certificate of Registration (CoR) as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) to RBI. RBI cancelled the CoR vide Cancellation Order dated 24th July, 2025. Company amended its MOA to reflect change in principal business objectives. Financial statements for year ended March 31, 2026 prepared as per new business activities.

During the year the Company has voluntarily surrendered its Certificate of Registration (CoR) as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). In response, RBI has vide its Cancellation Order dated 24th July, 2025 cancelled the CoR.
The Company is not a Nidhi Company.
The Company has not entered into non-cash transactions with directors or persons connected with its directors.
The Company has not incurred cash losses in the current financial year and in the immediately preceding financial year.
There has been no resignation of the statutory auditors during the year.
The provisions of section 135 of the Act are applicable to the Company. The Company has made the required contributions during the year and there are no unspent amounts.
The Company does not have any Subsidiary, Associate or Joint Venture.
